simple.meaning: אַדִּיר (ʼaddîyr) appears 27 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a daughter in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Chronicles, Nehemiah, and 6 more, beginning at Exodus 15:10. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship, land, wilderness, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַדִּיר (H117) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows אַדִּיר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: אַדִּיר (ʼaddîyr) / H117 is tracked through Exodus 15:10, Judges 5:13, Judges 5:25, 1 Samuel 4:8. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H117. addir אַדִּיר adjective majestic — ׳א Psa 8:2 +; feminine אַדֶּ֫רֶת Ezek 17:8 ? (see below) etc. — 1 majestic (wide, lofty) of waters of sea Exod 15:10 ; Psa 93:4 ; a ship Isa 33:21 ; a tree Ezek 17:23 ; a vine 17:8 ( אַדֶּרֶת גֶּפֶן , so Fü; or ׳א abstract noun see below אַדֶּרֶת below); also figurative of kings Psa 136:18 ; nations Ezek 32:18 ; gods 1Sam 4:8 ; of ׳י Psa 93:4 ; 76:5 ; of name of ׳י 8:2 ; Psalm 8:10. 2 substantive majestic one , of nobles, chieftains, etc., Judg 5:13 , 25 ; Nahum 2:6 ; 3:18 ; Jer 14:3 ; 25:34 ( הַצּאֹן אַדִּירֵי figurative so): 35.36; 30:21 ; Zech 11:2 ; 2Chr 23:20 ; Neh 3:5 ; 10:30 ; of ׳י Isa 10:34 ; 33:21 ; of servants of ׳י Psa 16:3 (= priests ? compare 1Chr 24:5 & see Che).
